items.gist: The concise initiation grants Śiva-hood without mandala, eve-rite, or ground-taking; the guru worships Śiva anywhere, meditates the path, and purifies each tattva with Parā-mantra, svāhā, and full oblation.
Offerings are made with the Parā-enclosed mantra in set counts, followed by 'pūrṇā' purification; tattvas may be purified singly by Mātṛkā-pair letters or by the condensed mantra.

The guru performs the concise rite only according to his realized knowledge; even then he contemplates the pervasion common to all paths, performs the scattered rite as identity unfolds, and this rule is taught in Dīkṣottara, Kiraṇa, and other scriptures.
